data.description: Explore tonnes of investment opportunities and an unparalleled lifestyle in the rapidly growing community of MBR City.

data.answer:
Some prominent projects in Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum City include Sobha Hartland Dubai, District One, Mag Eye at Meydan (formerly District 7), District 11, and Dubai Hills Estate.

Providing opulent living spaces and an elevated lifestyle, the residential units within this community adhere to green building standards to foster a natural environment and uphold efficient environmental practices. The types of residential properties available are MBR City apartments, villas, and MBR City townhouses.

The apartment offerings include studio, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom units in Sobha Hartland. Looking for a more spacious home? In District One, larger 4-bedroom flats extending over 3,000 sq. ft. are available. Those interested in luxury real estate investment can explore penthouses within this project, featuring options such as lagoon-facing, duplex, and those with partial canal views.

In MBR City's villa segment, you'll find a broad spectrum, from 2 to 6-bedroom family homes to expansive 8-bedroom mansions. District One is known for its extensive portfolio of off-plan properties for sale. In Mag Eye, a diverse selection of townhouses ranging from 2 to 5-bedroom units is currently exclusively available for sale.

Off-Plan Projects in Mohammed Bin Rashid City

Keturah Reserve, Eden Hill Villas, Casa Serene, and Opal Gardens are some of the top off-plan projects in MBR City Dubai. Located in the sub-community of Meydan, Keturah Reserve by MAG Group is a cluster of super homes ranging from 2 to 4-BHK apartments.

Similarly, Eden Hill Villas will feature 5 to 6-bedroom luxury villas with facilities including a kids' play area, a natural landscape, and walking trails.

Casa Serene is another upcoming villa community in the district that is expected to be completed in 2024. Investors can also explore the project of Opal Gardens, which features semi-detached villas and townhouses.

Renting A Property In Mohammed Bin Rashid City

There are quite a few popular areas to rent apartments in MBR City, including KOA Canvas, Sobha Hartland, and Gemini Splendor. The average rental price for a studio apartment in Sobha Hartland is AED 48,000, and the 1-BHK unit is AED 64,000. Those interested in renting a 2-bedroom flat in Sobha Hartland must pay about AED 101,000.

The average rental rate for studios in KOA Canvas is AED 76,000. For 1 and 2-BHK units, renters should expect around AED 92,000 and AED 156,000, respectively. In the Gemini Splendor building, a 1-bedroom flat is available for about AED 61,000.

Buying A Property In Mohammed Bin Rashid City

Sobha Hartland, The Residences, Sobha Creek Vistas, District 1, and District 7 all comprise apartments for sale in MBR City, while District 1, District 7, and Sobha Hartland also have excellent options for villas. The average sales price for a studio apartment in MBR City is 
AED 550,000, and a 1-BHK unit is available for AED 695,000. AED 1.03 million is the minimum price of a 2-bedroom apartment in the community.

If you want an MBR City villa, AED 3M is the minimum price for a 3-bedroom luxury home. For purchasing a 4-BHK house, you need at least AED 3.39M. Similarly, 5 and 6-bedroom Mohammed Bin Rashid City villas for sale are available for AED 6.99M and AED 11.6M, respectively.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Mohammed Bin Rashid City?

data.answer:
Life in Mohammed Bin Rashid City offers a unique blend of luxury, modernity, and convenience. Meydan One Mall, one of the world's biggest shopping malls, is a prominent feature, offering many retail shops, dining options, and entertainment facilities. Surrounded by notable Dubai landmarks and positioned amidst key roads like Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, Sheikh Zayed Road, and Al Khail Road, MBR City enjoys excellent connectivity.

Public Transportation Near MBR City

The city is conveniently situated near many metro stations, adding convenience for residents who rely on public transportation. Burj Khalifa/Dubai Mall Metro Station is nearest to the area, about an 11-minute drive. Additionally, buses and taxis are readily available for reaching in the vicinity. Bus stops near the area are:

  • Umm Suqeim, Dubai Municipality Center Bus Stop
  • Saeed Bin Huzeim Masjid Bus Stop

Supermarkets Near Mohammed Bin Rashid City

There are various supermarkets near MBR City. Carrefour is located close to Burj Khalifa and approximately a 12-minute drive from MBR City. Moreover, Lulu Express in Al Quoz is around 9 minutes away from the community. You can also find the Spinneys branch in the neighboring Meydan City’s Polo Residences.

Shopping Malls In Mohammed Bin Rashid City

MBR City is home to the expansive shopping destination, Meydan One Mall. It is among the premier malls in Dubai, housing over 600 retail establishments, including numerous renowned luxury brands, and boasting more than 100 food outlets.  
MBR City residents can also explore nearby shopping destinations such as Dubai Mall, Mercato Shopping Mall, and Mall of the Emirates, each located approximately 14 to 17 minutes away.

Schools and Nurseries in MBR City

There are two schools in Mohammed Bin Rashid City, both well-known international educational institutes. North London Collegiate School Dubai was established in 2017 and follows the International Baccalaureate (IB) curriculum until Year 12. Established in September 2015, Hartland International School follows the UK/IB curriculum. Both of these schools are located in the community. 
Following the Indian and IB curriculum, GEMS Modern Academy is a 20-minute drive away from MBR City. For community members looking for higher education options, Dubai International Academic City (DIAC), home to many of Dubai’s leading universities, is situated 20 minutes away from MBR City.

Churches, Temples and Mosques in Mohammed Bin Rashid City

Currently, MBR City does not have any places of worship within the community. However, numerous mosques are situated just a few minutes away in neighboring areas. Al Farooq Omar Bin Al Khattab Mosque, located in Al Safa, is approximately an 11-minute drive, while Ramadan Juma Mosque in Al Badaa is accessible within a 13-minute drive.

For Christian community members, The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints is situated 10 minutes away. Hindu residents can reach the Shiva and Krishna temples in Bur Dubai within a 20-minute drive. Moreover, the Sikh community living in the area can visit the Sikh Gurudwara conveniently located nearby.

Clinics And Hospitals in Mohammed Bin Rashid City

Emirates Hospital Dubai is located approximately 15 minutes away from MBR City. Aster Hospital and Mediclinic Welcare Hospital are also within a 15-minute drive of MBR City. Moreover, residents can check clinics in Business Bay, Downtown Dubai, or other nearby neighborhoods.

Mohammed Bin Rashid City Location And Nearby Areas

Strategically positioned, MBR City offers residents convenient access to numerous key areas in Dubai. Business Bay, Dubai Downtown, Dubai Design District, and Al Quoz are bordering Mohammed Bin Rashid City.

more_info.question: Things To Do in MBR City Dubai

data.answer:
MBR City’s strategic location facilitates easy access to major tourist destinations and commercial districts. The presence of the Meydan Hotel adds to the entertainment quotient, making MBR City an exciting community. Equestrian and falcon centers, various eateries, entertainment centers, and retail shops contribute to a vibrant and bustling atmosphere.

MBR City aims to provide ample outdoor spaces and activities for residents. A significant highlight is the 7-kilometer man-made lagoon, recognized as the world's largest, offering a tropical ambiance for recreational activities like swimming, paddle boarding, and surfing.
MBR City is continually evolving, with ongoing and planned projects contributing to its transformation into a major mixed-use development.

Restaurants Near MBR City Dubai

Residents have a diverse array of options, with eateries and cafes situated in the surrounding areas. Noteworthy casual dining establishments near MBR City include The Cheesecake Factory and P.F. Chang's in the Dubai Mall. For those seeking fine-dining experiences, At.mosphere in Burj Khalifa and Ewaan in The Palace Downtown Hotel are among the high-end restaurants available in Downtown Dubai.
Additionally, Downtown Dubai boasts numerous other cafes and eateries, including Amore Café, Al Hamidieh Downtown, and Caribou Coffee, adding to the culinary diversity in the vicinity.

Beaches Near MBR City

Approximately 12 to 15 minutes from the emirate's coastline, Mohammed Bin Rashid City provides easy access for residents seeking a sunny day out or a relaxing, breezy evening. MBR City residents can venture to Sunset Beach and Jumeirah Beach, both situated approximately 12 minutes away. Another nearby option is Kite Beach, which offers a range of water sports activities and a few food stalls.

Hotels Near Mohammed Bin Rashid City

Being mainly a residential community, MBR City doesn’t house hotels. However, there is an array of hotels near MBR City. These include the Premier Inn Dubai International Airport Hotel, the Radisson Blue Hotel, Dubai Media City, and the Lemon Tree Hotel Jumeirah.

Premier Inn is a well-known hotel chain with locations worldwide, including in Dubai. They are known for offering comfortable accommodations at affordable prices. The Radisson Blue Hotel is strategically located in Dubai Media City. All these establishments are about a 15-minute drive away from the area.

Attractions Near Mohammed Bin Rashid City

MBR City is surrounded by many renowned Dubai landmarks. The iconic Burj Khalifa, the world's tallest building, and Dubai Mall are situated just 15 minutes away from the city. Nestled at the end of Dubai Creek, the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary, a wetland preserve, is conveniently located within a 15- to 20-minute drive.

Safa Park, positioned in Al Safa, is 8 to 10 minutes away. It is recognized as one of Dubai's premier parks, spanning an expansive 64 hectares and offering a delightful family leisure space.
Golf enthusiasts can indulge in Meydan's golf course, The Track, accessible within a convenient 14-minute drive.

Other prominent golf courses close to MBR City include Dubai Creek Golf and Yacht Club, Emirates Golf Club, and Al Badia Golf. Meydan Racecourse is also conveniently located, just a 13-minute drive from the city.

The focal attraction of District One in MBR City is the impressive 7-kilometer man-made lagoon. Crafted by Crystal Lagoons, a company founded by Fernando Fischmann, this lagoon secures its place as the world’s largest man-made lagoon, as recognized by Guinness World Records.

Also located at the end of Dubai Creek, the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary, a wetland preserve, is easily accessible within a 15 to 20-minute drive.

Outdoor Activities and Fitness Facilities in Mohammed Bin Rashid City

Among the numerous upcoming developments in MBR City, a notable addition is the construction of a public park, drawing comparisons to iconic locations like London’s Hyde Park and anticipated to be even larger.

Near MBR City, Al Quoz Pond Park is a 5-minute drive away, providing an outdoor recreational space. The District One Cycling and Running Track, approximately 7 minutes from the central point of MBR City on Muscat Street, offers additional options for cycling enthusiasts. Over the next two years, several projects in MBR City are set to enhance the city's entertainment scene significantly.

While the city lacks gyms and beauty salons, residents can easily find other options nearby. Fitness centers in Al Quoz and Business Bay are easily accessible, requiring a commute of no longer than 10 to 15 minutes.

Community Events

Positioned amidst Dubai's major tourist attractions, Mohammed Bin Rashid City offers residents the opportunity to attend various events throughout the year. With Meydan Racecourse and Meydan’s Golf Course nearby, community members can also partake in sports-related activities.

MBR City is known for its luxury developments, and the cost of living in such areas can be relatively high. Also, since MBR City is a major urban development project, ongoing construction activities may exist. This can lead to noise, dust, and temporary inconveniences for residents.

Who is the developer of MBR City?

Meydan Group is the developer of Mohammed Bin Rashid City (MBR City) in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Renowned for its expertise in real estate and property development, Meydan Group has spearheaded multiple projects, including the impressive Meydan Racecourse and Grandstand.

What is the area of MBR City?

Situated at the center of Dubai, MBR City spans an impressive 54 million square feet, standing as one of the world's most ambitious and extensive mixed-use developments. This remarkable project integrates residential, commercial, and leisure ventures on a grand scale.

Are there any outdoor and fitness facilities in the area?

Numerous fitness facilities, including Flywheel Sports and GymNation, are nearby. Residents can also partake in a range of outdoor activities and sports amenities, including cycling and jogging tracks, football fields, tennis and basketball courts, as well as golf courses.

What does MBR City stand for?

MBR City Dubai stands for Mohammed Bin Rashid City.

Should I invest in the properties in MBR City?

The diverse selection of properties in MBR City positions it as an attractive opportunity for both local and international investors.

What are the key attractions in Mohammed Bin Rashid City?

Key attractions in Mohammed Bin Rashid City (MBR City) include the Meydan One Mall, Dubai Water Canal, District One Crystal Lagoon, and various parks and recreational facilities.

What residential options are available in Mohammed Bin Rashid City?

MBR City offers a variety of residential options including luxurious villas, townhouses, and apartments.

Is Mohammed Bin Rashid City family-friendly?

Yes, MBR City is family-friendly, with numerous parks, schools, and recreational facilities designed to cater to families.

What are the transportation options in Mohammed Bin Rashid City?

Transportation options in MBR City include access to major highways, public buses, and plans for future metro connectivity.

How does Mohammed Bin Rashid City contribute to Dubai’s vision for the future?

MBR City contributes to Dubai’s vision for the future by providing sustainable, luxurious living spaces, enhancing tourism, and fostering economic growth with its state-of-the-art infrastructure and world-class amenities.

data.content:
Mohammed Bin Rashid City, commonly known as MBR City, is one of Dubai's largest mixed-use developments with plenty of residential, commercial, and leisure options. His Highness Sheikh Mohammed Bin Rashid inaugurated this significant project in 2015.

The district houses top tourist attractions, a gigantic shopping center, an extensive park, the largest man-made lagoon, and 45 million sq. ft. of freehold area. It features a mix of high-rise and mid-rise apartments, villas, and townhouses.

District One is the central part of MBR City, while other sub-communities in the area include  District 11, Gemini Splendor, District 7, and KOA Canvas. Mohammed Bin Rashid City is strategically located between Sheikh Zayed Road, Emirates Road, and Al Khail Road.

nodes.title: Riverton House
nodes.about:
Riverton House by Ellington is a boutique residential project in Mohammed Bin Rashid City, offering 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments alongside retail units. Thoughtfully designed, the development blends contemporary architecture with serene natural surroundings, creating an address that balances modern living with everyday comfort.

Developed by Ellington Properties, Riverton House presents a lifestyle and investment opportunity in one of Dubai’s most dynamic locations. With curated amenities, retail convenience, and strong connectivity, the project combines quality design with high ROI potential, making it equally attractive for end-users and investors.

nodes.title: Gate Eleven
nodes.about:
Nestled within the vibrant MBR City District 11, Gate Eleven presents a refined residential community that perfectly balances modern luxury and everyday convenience. Developed by AMWAJ Development, this distinguished project features four residential buildings offering elegant 1 and 2-bedroom apartments. Designed for urban professionals and families alike, the development integrates well-appointed living spaces with a suite of lifestyle-enhancing amenities.

Residents of Gate Eleven Residences at MBR City will enjoy access to swimming pools, fully equipped gyms, a dedicated boxing studio, and a serene yoga studio. Additional conveniences include retail outlets for daily essentials and a kids' play area. What truly sets this project apart are its open, uninterrupted views over the surrounding park, lagoon, and upscale villa communities—an inspiring backdrop to everyday life.

nodes.title: Selora Residences
nodes.about:
Selora Residences at MBR City is a limited-edition gated community by Swank Development, offering an elevated lifestyle in the heart of Dubai. Comprising just 30 luxurious 4, 5 and 6-bedroom villas. Each residence is thoughtfully appointed with private swimming pools, elevators, landscaped gardens, and cutting-edge smart home automation. From outdoor family lounges and BBQ gardens to jogging trails and bespoke interiors, every detail caters to refined living.

Swank Development’s Selora Residences blends nature-inspired elemental architecture with contemporary comforts, delivering a sanctuary defined by serenity and sophistication. At the heart of the community lies Laguna Maré – a swimmable crystal lagoon, along with Casa Selora, an elegant clubhouse for social and leisure gatherings. Crafted with premium materials and open-plan layouts, this wellness-focused retreat embraces sustainability while offering a flexible 40/60 payment plan tailored for discerning buyers.

nodes.title: D1 West
nodes.about:
D1 West - a luxury development that is a collection of 4-6 bedroom villas located along the coastline and 7 bedroom mansions located on a separate island. Each residence has its own private pool. Each villa has a unique design in a modern style. High quality natural materials are used in the finishing, and thanks to panoramic windows all the wall rooms are filled with natural light and creates a cosy atmosphere.

Residents have access to a private beach by a picturesque lagoon, a small but cosy park with many places for recreation and jogging and walking paths and a green garden with playgrounds and sports grounds. There are schools, nurseries, shops and a mosque within walking distance.

D1 West has a unique location in MBR City. Meydan Racecourse, Meydan Golf, the famous Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary and the Business Bay area are just 5 minutes away. Burj Al Arab, Palm Jumeirah and Dubai International Airport can be reached in 15 minutes.

The complex offers a unique resort lifestyle to suit all ages. Surrounded by a lagoon and green spaces, the villas are the perfect place for those seeking comfort and harmony.

nodes.title: Amaal 8
nodes.about:
Amaal 8 at Meydan Horizon, Dubai offers a luxurious lifestyle in a prime location within the Meydan Horizon masterplan, across from the tranquil Mohammed Bin Rashid City. Rising across 48 levels, Amaal 8 redefines contemporary living with 512 elegantly designed units, including the exclusive Infinity Collection Residences.

You can choose from 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments in various layouts, each offering different views. Whether you want to enjoy the sparkling lagoon, the verdant golf course or just the Dubai skyline, you'll find your perfect view at Amaal 8. This project by Amaal Emirates, a part of Ayana Holdings, is a perfect blend of urban convenience and serene natural beauty, offering breathtaking views of Downtown Dubai, the Crystal Lagoon, and Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary. With smart living technology integrated into each unit, convenience and luxury are at the forefront of the Amaal 8 experience, making these apartments ideal for those seeking an elevated lifestyle in Dubai.

nodes.title: The Highgrove
nodes.about:
The Highgrove in MBR City by Ellington Properties introduces a new standard of luxury living, offering a variety of residences, including one to three-bedroom apartments, penthouses, duplexes, and sky villas. Nestled in a prime location near Downtown Dubai and the World Islands, it promises connectivity and exclusivity, making it a sought-after destination for modern living.  

The project boasts exceptional amenities, including a crystal lagoon with sun loungers, an infinity-edge leisure pool, fitness studios, a clubhouse, children’s indoor and outdoor play areas, and a flotation therapy pool. These thoughtfully designed features create an oasis of relaxation amidst Dubai's vibrant energy.  

Ellington’s The Highgrove caters to diverse lifestyles, offering expansive spaces for comfort and elegance. With convenient Highgrove payment plans and proximity to iconic landmarks, the development provides an unmatched opportunity for Mohammed Bin Rashid City property investment. Whether for living or investment, this project offers a lifestyle that is both fulfilling and luxurious in one of Dubai’s most prestigious communities.
